home.intro: In the heart of the Florentine Chianti, where the air is fragrant with history and the light caresses the hills so typical of this land, Horses of Florence was born: here the horse is not only a companion, but a guide.
home.gates: Here, at the gates of Florence, meeting the horse becomes an experience that transforms.

moments.rest: opens a new space: one of listening, of presence, of truth.

nature: Horses live immersed in nature and express their essence, and that is precisely why they can recognise ours.
They read us without words, welcome us without judgement, and lead us back to a balance we often forget.

centre.lead: Horses of Florence is an invitation
body: It is a journey that brings together the beauty of the Florentine countryside and the depth of the relationship with the horse.
A journey that speaks of authenticity, of harmony, of a return to oneself, for the person and for the horse alike.

remember.first: Here you do not come only to learn: you come to remember.

for_you.title: For you
for_you.text: Among the vineyards and olive groves so typical of our land, we welcome you individually or in small groups of two, at most three riders, so that the instructor can take care of even the smallest details, with the support of our horses or your own, which we will be happy to host at our partner facility, a riding centre affiliated with the Italian Equestrian Sports Federation, with the support of qualified staff.
for_you.lead: Together, we will practise channelling with the horses, both on the ground and in the saddle:
items: To improve the bond with your four-legged friend, whether a companion in life or at work;

With the help of the horses, to overcome the emotional blocks that sometimes weigh on us, to find ourselves again, or simply to regenerate and recover the precious energy that our hectic lives sometimes take from us.
for_you.closing: Together with you, we plan your holidays with us, or your free time, on a journey towards yourself.

experiences.title: Choose your experiences

items.text: When your time with the horses is over, you can visit fortified villages, small towns and castles, rich in culture and age-old traditions, and get to know the cities of Siena and Florence, famous all over the world.
If you feel like it, you will see important tourist destinations, some just half an hour away. You can relax by the pool, play padel or go sport fishing near the B&B.

If you feel like it, you will explore the surrounding countryside by bike (bikes can be hired) or on foot, walking along the Pesa stream from the B&B all the way to Cerbaia in Val di Pesa, on a dedicated cycle path.
You can also taste excellent local olive oils and wines at fine producers where tradition and innovation create excellence.

experiences.closing: And so you will set out to discover yourself, with the support of our wonderful animals or with your own horse, so that every step shared in our land is a return to who you truly are.

contact.title: Contact
contact.invite: Don’t wait until tomorrow to take care of yourself, of you both.
contact.mobile_note: Mobile: SMS and WhatsApp calls only.

requirements: Knowledge of the three gaits required
